cells.gaps: No source found reports a shared digital text applied across a border in the last three years beyond the start of a customs pilot.
cells.note: Togo ratified the Malabo Convention in 2021 (TGO-002), and in March 2025 the revenue office issued a notice applying its 2024 protocol with the Sahel States on linking customs IT systems (TGO-003, TGO-004). The notice starts a pilot, which is not yet a reported use across a border, so not 5.
